name: xenomoon-webapp
description: Web app domain package for React + Node.js. Ships an issue-driven, human-gated pipeline — product-owner (PRD) → junior-analyst (triage) → senior-analyst (solution) → developer (implement) → tester (QA) → reviewer (audit) — with /feedback /design /triage /solution /implement /qa /audit /commit /build /uat commands. Generic head start; learns each project's conventions on top.
